result.summary: Removed the 2022 standing value statements 'BETTER LIVES' (removing obstacles to progress), 'STRONGER COMMUNITIES' (bonds with employees, union partners, customers, and communities) and 'HEALTHIER PLANET' (creating a sustainable future). The 2023 text swaps them for a report promo about 'measurable gains' against sustainability targets, so the page's standing commitments are dropped.}
